column1: # Screens tier 2 owes that no screen draws yet: GOLDEN, the issue that
# owes the screen, and why. The run reports each row as a pending case. A
# row that a screen draws, or whose golden goldens/ holds, is refused. A
# screen that takes one up adds its golden, and the row goes.

column3: Arabic in Iosevka Term's 16x40 cell, waiting for a decision on how a joining letter fits a cell much wider or narrower than it: each letter is stretched or squeezed sideways to its cell (ADR-1302 D2), so alef and lam draw nearly twice as heavy as the letters beside them and final seen is squeezed to half its width

Hindi and Bengali in Iosevka Term's 16x40 cell, waiting for a decision on how a syllabic cluster maps onto cells (vtium/vtium#144): a cluster of several characters draws at its full width over its neighbours, and a single letter is drawn smaller to fit its one cell, so words collide and letters change size
